source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The patch adds appearance:none to .toolbarbutton-menubutton-button and .toolbarbutton-1 in the macOS mail stylesheet. Current source retains both declarations beside the existing dropmarker opt-out and local checked/open/inactive styles. This is a scoped rendering choice for these button classes, not a global styling or accessibility rule. It changes no labels, roles or commands. No native hover, focus, screenshot or accessibility test was run.
title: macOS mail toolbar button classes explicitly opt out of native appearance
